description: At 390 px wide the Verification code input is 168 px wide because its label sits beside it. The 19-character code does not fit: the placeholder is cut to 'a1b2 c3d4 e5f6' and a typed code shows only its last three groups, so the user cannot check what they typed before approving.
expected: Label above a full-width input on narrow screens.
actual: Measured input width 168 px at left 189 px.
suggested_fix: Stack label above input below ~480 px.

description: Typing letters outside the allowed set (vowels, Y) is accepted and shown, then Continue says 'Enter the code in the form XXXX-XXXX.' The form is correct; the page never says which letters are valid. The code `JCFA-AEIO` looks as valid as the printed code.
expected: Say 'Codes use only consonants, check for A, E, I, O, U, Y' or reject characters as typed.
actual: Enter the code in the form XXXX-XXXX.
suggested_fix: Drop vowels as the user types or name the letters in the error.

description: 'This code is wrong, expired, or already used' does not tell a typo from an expired code; the user cannot decide whether to retype or rerun login.
expected: Suggest 'check for typos first; if it is right, run agent-drive login again'.
suggested_fix: Order advice: re-check the code, then rerun login.

description: The status tag reads 'NO PAIRING' after a plain input error (empty box, wrong format) when no lookup happened, which implies the lookup failed.
expected: Keep 'AWAITING CODE' until a lookup fails.
actual: Tag changes to NO PAIRING on empty submit.
suggested_fix: Only set NO PAIRING after a 404.

description: There is no link to /connect in the header or console nav; a user with the agent on another machine must know the URL (the CLI prints it, console Agents shows only the llms.txt prompt).
expected: A 'Connect an agent' route reachable from the console that explains typing the code.
